This project is the MVP for the Balikpapan Traffic Jam Web App. Follow the PRD for all requirements. Use React, TypeScript, Vite, pnpm, Convex backend, and Google Maps JavaScript API. Implement only MVP/Phase 1 features. Do not implement any Phase 2 or future features.
